description: A chunky low-poly six-wheeled military cargo truck parked on the ground, seen from the front-left. A boxy flat-fronted cab at the front with a flat slatted grille, two square flat headlights, a flat two-pane windscreen and a flat roof; behind the cab a long flat cargo bed with low flat side boards, covered by a tall canvas tilt: a boxy cover with a gently rounded top and flat sides stretched over hoops, the hoops showing as slight vertical ridges along the side. Six large chunky wheels of the same size: one axle under the cab and two close-set axles under the rear of the cargo bed. Cab and cargo bed side boards painted one desert tan; canvas cover a slightly darker sand khaki; bumper, grille slats and fuel tank under the cab door dark gunmetal grey; windscreen and cab side windows a single flat dark blue-grey; tyres dark charcoal, hubs dark tan; headlights pale grey. The open rear end of the canvas cover and the tailgate on the rear face face away and are hidden; the right-hand wheels are hidden behind the truck.
proportions: About 8.0 m long, 2.5 m wide and 3.3 m tall; the six wheels clearly visible. (length : width : height = 3.20 : 1 : 1.32)
sides: the supply truck is symmetric left to right: the spare wheel stands upright on the centre line behind the cab, a mirror on each cab corner, a fuel tank under each cab door.
